title: Evidence map: PB2 markers in NL otters (May 2021 – Dec 2022)
caption: The corpus has the global mammalian-adaptation review (E627K/D701N recur) and NL 2021–22 outbreak context (otters among 26 events), but no PB2 genotype calls for the otters — whether they carried E627K or D701N cannot be answered.
